newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran to hold amphibious wargames on Gulf coast.
newsitem.headline: Iran to hold amphibious wargames on Gulf coast.

text.p: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guards will stage amphibious wargames in the southern province of Bushehr, Iran's official news agency IRNA reported on Sunday.

It quoted the Commander of Regional Resistance Brigadier General Abbas Alavi Nejad as saying 50 battalions of guards would take part in the manoeuvres code-named "Tariq-ol Qods" (Road to Jerusalem). He did not say when they would begin.
Iran said on Tuesday its army would hold amphibious wargames in the Gulf this week to train for surprise attacks against "enemies" posing threats to the Islamic Republic.
Revolutionary Guards Commander General Mohsen Rezaei was quoted as saying 200,000 troops and volunteer Bassij forces would take part.
Iran holds wargames in the Gulf regularly.
